title: Sr. Manager, Mission Engineering & Operations
text:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good. 

 At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

 Your Impact 

 You will lead a team of Mission Engineers who serve as Axon’s embedded builders and operational partners inside strategic public safety agencies. Mission Engineers work face-to-face with the people doing the work, diagnose how the agency operates, and build the workflows, automations, integrations, and AI-enabled solutions that measurably improve it.

 As Senior Manager, you will create the environment in which that work succeeds. You will coach experienced individual contributors, set a clear bar for technical delivery and agency partnership, and help the team turn ambiguous field problems into secure, maintainable solutions that reach production and earn sustained adoption. You will stay close enough to the portfolio to recognize patterns, anticipate risk, and connect what the team learns in the field back to Product, Engineering, and the broader organization.

 Success is reflected in agencies becoming more capable, Mission Engineers growing into trusted transformation leaders, and strong field solutions becoming reusable patterns that benefit customers beyond a single engagement. Axon’s mission is to Protect Life, and this team is one of the most direct ways we advance that mission alongside the agencies we serve.

 What You’ll Do 

 Location: Southeast US Regionally based with Travel up to 40%
 Reports to: Senior Director, Customer Deployment & Mission Engineering
 Direct Reports: Individual Contributors

 Lead, Coach, and Develop Mission Engineers

 
 Lead and develop a distributed team of embedded Mission Engineers working across strategic agency environments

 Coach individual contributors through complex technical decisions, ambiguous customer problems, executive conversations, and high-stakes delivery moments

 Establish clear expectations for ownership, technical quality, onsite partnership, production delivery, adoption, documentation, and measurable agency impact

 Build individualized development plans and create opportunities for Mission Engineers to expand their technical range, executive presence, and transformation leadership

 Foster a culture of curiosity, candor, responsible experimentation, continuous learning, and shared accountability

 Support thoughtful team growth by selecting and onboarding people who can both build practical solutions and earn credibility with agency stakeholders

 
 Set the Bar for Agency Outcomes

 
 Ensure Mission Engineers begin with the agency’s mission, operational workflow, and desired outcome before selecting or building a solution

 Require clear baselines, success criteria, and adoption measures so impact is demonstrated rather than assumed

 Guide the team from discovery through production use, iteration, handoff, and sustained adoption

 Help Mission Engineers balance immediate agency needs with secure, maintainable, and scalable solution design

 Reinforce that success means the agency is more capable—not that one individual has become indispensable

 
 Own a Strategic Mission Engineering Portfolio

 
 Maintain visibility across strategic agencies, active builds, adoption progress, technical risk, and emerging operational needs

 Match Mission Engineer capability and level to agency complexity, transformation opportunity, and stakeholder environment

 Use operating reviews and portfolio data to identify delivery risks, recurring friction, adoption barriers, and opportunities for reuse

 Step into critical situations with structure and calm while coaching the accountable Mission Engineer to remain in ownership

 Drive consistent execution across embedded engagements without forcing every agency problem into the same playbook

 
 Advance Technical and AI-Enabled Delivery

 
 Maintain sufficient fluency across SaaS, cloud services, APIs, enterprise integrations, hardware, data, and modern AI tooling to coach technical decisions and challenge weak reasoning

 Help the team decide when to configure the platform, when to extend it, and when a net-new build is justified

 Establish expectations for validation, observability, fallback paths, maintainability, documentation, and responsible use of sensitive data

 Ensure solutions uphold CJIS requirements, evidence integrity, privacy, approved-tooling standards, and other applicable security controls

 Encourage practical use of AI to accelerate work while preserving human ownership of architecture, accuracy, and outcomes

 
 Turn Field Learning Into Organizational Leverage

 
 Build mechanisms for Mission Engineers to document and share reusable workflows, integrations, frameworks, and playbooks

 Identify patterns across agencies and help convert successful one-off solutions into repeatable capabilities

 Create strong feedback loops with Product and Engineering around recurring workflow friction, unmet operational needs, and product opportunities

 Partner with Mission Operators, Customer Success, Deployment, Professional Services, Support, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Enablement so agencies experience coordinated execution

 Share portfolio insights with senior leaders to influence investment, prioritization, staffing, and the evolution of the Mission Engineering operating model

 
 Lead Executive and Agency Engagement

 
 Build trusted relationships with command staff, agency executives, technical leaders, and internal senior leadership

 Serve as a senior partner during agency-impacting incidents, high-visibility deployments, and moments that require clear trade-offs or executive alignment

 Translate complex technical and operational issues into decisions that are clear to both technical teams and executive audiences

 Coach Mission Engineers to challenge requests constructively, communicate candidly, and leave stakeholders with a practical path forward

 
 What You Bring

 Required

 
 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical delivery, systems integration, solutions engineering, implementation consulting, operational transformation, or comparable environments

 5+ years leading and developing senior technical individual contributors in customer-facing organizations

 Demonstrated success coaching teams that deliver secure, production-ready solutions in complex customer environments

 Experience leading distributed or field-based teams across multiple customers, regions, or engagement models

 A record of improving technical execution, adoption, operational outcomes, and delivery consistency across a portfolio

 Broad technical fluency across SaaS platforms, cloud services, APIs, networking, hardware, integrations, data workflows, and AI-enabled technologies

 Executive presence with the ability to earn trust, communicate trade-offs, and guide decisions with command staff and senior leaders

 Strong systems thinking and the ability to distinguish isolated issues from patterns that require a scalable solution

 A data-informed leadership approach using baselines, production delivery, adoption, operational improvement, quality, and reuse to evaluate performance

 Comfort leading through ambiguity while creating clarity around ownership, priorities, and success criteria

 Ability to obtain and maintain CJIS compliance and exercise sound judgment with highly sensitive information

 
 Preferred

 
 Experience in public safety, law enforcement, defense, government technology, or another mission-critical operating environment

 Familiarity with CAD, RMS, digital evidence, real-time operations, or integrated public safety ecosystems

 Experience leading teams that build automations, integrations, operational workflows, internal tools, or AI-enabled solutions

 Experience converting field-developed solutions into reusable frameworks, product improvements, or organizational playbooks

 Familiarity with technical talent development, competency frameworks, or academy-style enablement programs

 
 Additional Information

 We recognize that leaders may arrive through different paths. If you have developed technically curious customer-facing teams, helped people turn ambiguous operational problems into working solutions, and care deeply about measurable customer impact, we encourage you to apply.

 Benefits that Benefit You

 
 Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

 Discretionary paid time off

 Paid parental leave for all

 Medical, Dental, Vision plans

 Fitness Programs

 Emotional & Mental Wellness support

 Learning & Development programs

 And yes, we have snacks in our offices

 
 

 Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.
 Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

 Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

 Important Notes 

 The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions. 

 Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment. 

 We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form . Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment. 

 We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com. Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes. 

 Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process. All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers . If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com , or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com .
